title: Newly Established Solar Projects Business Equity Stake For Sale in Hyderabad, India
tagline: We're kicking off a new venture focusing on solar power projects right here in Hyderabad. - Currently, we operate as under the brand name of our existing business, but this new business will be a separate entity soon. - We've already signed a deal for a massive 200 MW solar project, with two more projects ready to roll out. - The total worth of our ongoing and upcoming projects is set to exceed INR 1000 crore. - We’re a tight-knit team of 7 passionate employees who are excited about the future of renewable energy. - Our business involves BOOT and PPA model which will provide a steady income from our clients who purchase our solar generated electricity. - Investors will get a 20% stake in this new solar venture, but please note this is separate from our existing real estate business. - We're in the process of getting this new venture registered.
